input.selectedRowRule: Exactly one JSONL object with pdbId equal to 1CZ8; raw-line hash excludes the line-feed terminator.

positiveSourceFacts.fact: The complete retained inventory contains VEGFA annotated with UniProt P15692, a 214-residue neutralizing-antibody light chain and a 231-residue neutralizing-antibody heavy chain. The numbered-heavy lead is entity 3.
Fresh exact-identifier Europe PMC/PubMed and Crossref metadata identify DOI 10.1006/jmbi.1999.3192 as a publication about an affinity-matured anti-VEGF Fab complex.

auditInference.statement: The heavy-domain lead has positive deposited heavy/light-chain context and exact-publication Fab context. A heavy-domain call does not establish VHH format. The publication identity is a preparation-review lead rather than proof of an eligible GPCR–VHH pair.
notEstablished: The exact expressed construct identity and processing from primary preparation Methods.
Binder ancestry or overlap with any other retained anti-VEGF antibody.
A source-reviewed direct GPCR–VHH pair meeting frozen eligibility criteria.
Formal whole-entry exclusion or proof that every possible relevant binder is absent.
auditInference.annotationCaveat: Deposited antibody source-organism metadata report Mus musculus. No unreported species composition, humanization or construct-processing history is inferred. The Crossref title carries an editorial suffix absent from PubMed and deposition metadata; the exact DOI and publication identity agree.

continuation: Retain the positive format/target context without converting it into a formal disposition. If formal disposition is required, obtain permitted primary preparation/construct and deposition evidence. Do not repeatedly retry the same failed publisher route without new access evidence.
scopeLimit: This review concerns only 1CZ8 and its 3 deposited polymer entities. It supplies neither an absence proof nor any bound for the phrase-only remainder or whole census.
